name: openzoo
author: stacc
description: Ask 400+ models from the Omarchy bar with no account, no API key and no subscription. Every call is priced before it runs and paid per request from a local burner wallet over x402, so there is nothing to sign up for and nothing to cancel. Shows live spend, and does semantic recall over your own holographically-bound corpus when a leCore daemon is running.

barWidget.description: Ask any model, no account and no API key. Pays per call from a local wallet, shows live spend, and searches your own bound corpus.

schema.label: openzoo proxy
schema.description: Local x402-paying proxy, started by `openzoo claude`. Localhost is keyless by design, so there is no token here.

schema.label: Ask model
schema.description: Which model answers the question box. Any id from GET /v1/models.

schema.label: leCore daemon
schema.description: Local holographic memory daemon. Default is loopback — nothing leaves this machine.

schema.label: Daemon token
schema.description: Bearer token the local daemon expects.

schema.label: Context id
schema.description: Optional. Leave empty to search everything openzoo-ingest has bound (all sources); set a ctx_... to pin one corpus.

schema.label: Retrieval breadth
schema.description: Slices returned per query. Breadth is the real quality knob.

schema.label: openzoo key (optional)
schema.description: LEAVE EMPTY FOR FULLY LOCAL. Setting an ozk_live_ key opts in to hosted models and cross-machine corpora, and sends queries off this machine.
